apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xqueues.messaging.example.org
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: "compositionfactory"
spec:
  # group/kind for the composite resource this XRD defines
  group: messaging.example.org
  names:
    kind: XQueue
    plural: xqueues
  claimNames:
    kind: Queue
    plural: queues
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                # queue depth requested by the caller
                maxDepth:
                  type: integer
                region:
                  type: string
                  default: "us-east-1"
              required:
                - region

apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xqueues.messaging.example.org
  labels:
    crossplane.io/xrd: "xqueues.messaging.example.org"
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: messaging.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XQueue
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    # patch-and-transform does the bulk of the field wiring
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          - name: queue
            base:
              apiVersion: sqs.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Queue
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: "us-east-1"
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
  annotations:
    # pinned so `cf gen` output is reproducible across runs
    meta.crossplane.io/maintainer: "compositionfactory"
spec:
  package: "xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.7.0"
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: "xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.5.0"
  # marks the composite Ready once every composed resource reports Ready
